BANDIT KNIGHT
CR 7

XP 3,200
CG Small humanoid (reptilian)
Init +1, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 11, flat-footed 20 (+8 armor, +1 Dex, +2 shield)
hp 66 (7d12 +21)
Fort +8, Ref +3, Will +4 immune to fear effects

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee +1 longsword +14/+9 (1d6 +5/19-20)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 13, Con 16, Int 11, Wis 15, Cha 11
Base Atk +6; CMB +10, CMD 28

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Barbarian Abilities (Ex)

Kasai has many barbarian abilities, including the following: rage, improved uncanny dodge, trapsense +1.

Haste (Su)

Aurora can act as if under the effects of haste for five rounds per day. These rounds need not be continuous.
